open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer publisher
open_points.text: A pointer carries “the instant it was published and by which principal (M07)”, but an imported pointer’s “publisher is therefore the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a principal”.
open_points.question: What publisher fact does an imported ArtifactPointer carry: an ActingPrincipal, a MigrationClosure, no publisher, or a provenance value that can contain either?
options: Every pointer publisher is an ActingPrincipal; imported pointers name the owner who performed the import
A publisher may be either an ActingPrincipal or the MigrationClosure
Imported pointers have no publisher fact
Add a migration/system kind to ActingPrincipal
open_points.default_guess: Make publisher provenance a choice between ActingPrincipal and MigrationClosure, following the explicit import sentence.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry identity
open_points.text: “Every identity Registry mints — `project_id`, `room_id`, artifact pointer id, `customer_ref` — is an opaque identifier… UUID”, followed by “Two further identifiers Registry mints”, omits AuditEntry, while M09 says its sequence number is “minted by Registry” and “is what tells them apart”.
open_points.question: Is the ordinal sequence number the AuditEntry’s identity and an explicit exception to the UUID identity rule, or does an AuditEntry also need a UUID identity distinct from its ordering sequence?
options: The sequence number is the identity and is an explicit ordinal exception
AuditEntry has a UUID identity plus a separate sequence number
AuditEntry has no model identity; the sequence is ordering metadata only
open_points.default_guess: Treat the sequence number as the AuditEntry identity and explicitly exempt it from the UUID rule.

open_points.subject: Audit entries for unchanged confirmed actions
open_points.text: R0-58 says Registry records “only significant changes of state”; re-archiving an archived project and re-anonymising an anonymised project return them unchanged, yet the confirmation-id section says a confirmed archiving or erasure writes its id “into the audit entry of that action”, and M09 lists “archiving” and “anonymising” without excluding unchanged repetitions.
open_points.question: Does a confirmed action that succeeds by returning an already archived or already anonymised project unchanged create an AuditEntry and retain its confirmation id?
options: No entry because no state changed
Write an accepted action entry despite no state change
Write entries only for specified unchanged actions, with the set named explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Write no entry for an unchanged repetition, because the audit log is limited to changes of state.
